messages:
maya: Following the postmortem, quick triage: we have recurring surge patterns at ~09:00 UTC on weekdays and spiky preemption at month-end. Need concrete owners for quota, scheduler tuning, and headroom automation.
priya: I can own the quota interaction with cloud billing and submit the formal increase request. Will propose a 2-week temporary burst then reassess. ETA: Thu COB. :white_check_mark:
ben: I'll take the usage pattern analysis and run a weekend vs weekday breakdown, plus a cost delta for the temp burst vs steady increase. Posting a short doc.
sasha: Scheduler tuning here. I want to test two knobs: aggressive backfill for batch classes and raise the soft preemption threshold. Will stage changes behind feature flags.
ugo: I'll handle headroom automation and the alerting cadence. Idea: add a predictive headroom metric (1h forecast) to trigger pre-buys or autoscale policies.
liam: I'll own the rollout coordination and the canary checklist. I can run the 2-hour validation window and take notes for the incident runbook.
ops-bot: Ticket created: INC-4002 (quota-request-temp-burst) linked.
maya: Good. Ben, can you include a table of how many denials we'd avoid at 10/15/20% buffers? That helps finance.
ben: Sure — initial numbers show 10% buffer reduces denials by ~60%, 20% by ~85%. Will attach CSV to INC-4002.
priya: Question for finance: do we need a CAPEX sign-off or can this be handled out of cloud spend ops? I'm pinging @finance in the ticket.
sasha: Scheduler plan (staging):
```
- set soft_preempt = 0.3 -> 0.45
- backfill_window = 30s -> 60s for batch-low
- enable fastpath for priority < 10
```
I'll keep continuous-batch cap at 48 for canary.
maya: Sasha add metric hooks: preemption_count, queue_wait_ms_p95, tail_gpu_util. Put graphs on the canary dashboard.
ugo: For headroom runbook I'll add steps: monitor predictive_headroom, if <12% then (1) increase reserved pool, (2) trigger quota temp-burst, (3) notify oncall. Draft PR will live in infra/playbooks/incident-runbooks.
liam: Canary schedule: staging Tue 09:00 UTC, canary Wed 09:00 UTC for 4 hours, rollback window 30m. I'll open a calendar invite.
ops-bot: Reminder: Canary run scheduled Wed 2026-03-25T09:00Z.
maya: Owners recap: Priya -> INC-4002 quota request (Thu), Ben -> usage/cost analysis + CSV (Wed), Sasha -> scheduler staging + metrics (staging Tue), Ugo -> headroom automation + runbook PR (Fri), Liam -> canary coordination + docs (Wed). I'll follow up in 24h.
priya: Filed the quota request: https://go/redwood/tickets/INC-4002. Assigned to infra-provisioning.
ben: Uploaded sim CSV and a short notebook to the ticket. Key insight: month-end spikes are correlated with scheduled exports from partner X.
sasha: Added the scheduler feature-flag PR: https://go/redwood/prs/7890 — contains toggles and metrics hooks.
ugo: Drafted runbook PR: https://go/redwood/prs/7891 — includes predictive_headroom calc and alert mappings to ops-bot.
liam: Added canary checklist in the ticket and invited infra, sre, and oncall.
maya: One more thing: recurring incident pattern task — assign a monthly postmortem review owner to detect regressions. Who volunteers?
ben: I can take the monthly pattern review (first Monday of month). Will produce a short slide deck.
priya: Add a dashboard panel for continuous_preemption_events and predictive_headroom trend. I'll coordinate with observability to get 90d retention.
ops-bot: Action created: PMR-1 (monthly-pattern-review) assigned to ben, recurring monthly.
maya: Great. If any ETA slips, update the ticket and ping here. Thanks everyone.
